items.text: It was the band's first record with Barry Stern on drums, and four of its songs got music videos.
items.why: Lead: 'the first Trouble album to have Barry Stern on drums. Music videos were made for' four named songs.
Infobox: 'Labels: Def American , Hammerheart' (Hammerheart is the 2020 reissue label per the Lead).

items.text: Eric Wagner (vocals), Bruce Franklin (guitars), Rick Wartell (guitars), Ron Holzner (bass), Barry Stern (drums), Jeff Olson (keyboards)
items.why: Personnel: band members as listed; 'Additional musicians: Jeff Olson – keyboards'.

items.text: David Bianco and Jimmy Heyson engineered the record, with Brian Jenkins as assistant engineer.
items.why: Personnel: 'David Bianco, Jimmy Heyson – engineers; Brian Jenkins – assistant engineer'.

items.text: Eric Wagner, Bruce Franklin and Rick Wartell wrote all of the tracks.
items.why: Track listing: 'All tracks are written by Eric Wagner, Bruce Franklin, and Rick Wartell'.

items.text: The original version was mastered by Greg Fulginiti at Artisan Sound Recorders in Los Angeles.
items.why: Personnel: 'Greg Fulginiti – mastering at Artisan Sound Recorders in Los Angeles, California (original version)'.

items.text: Hammerheart Records reissued and remastered the album on 27 November 2020, working with Trouble, Inc.
items.why: Lead: 'reissued and remastered by Hammerheart Records, cooperating alongside Trouble, Inc., on November 27, 2020'.

items.text: For that 2020 version, Erwin Hermsen remastered it at Toneshed Recording Studio in the Netherlands.
items.why: Personnel: 'Erwin Hermsen – remastering at Toneshed Recording Studio in The Netherlands (2020 version)'.

items.text: A DVD of the videos came out in 2007 on the band's Trouble, Inc. label.
items.why: Lead: 'the music videos were released on the Videos DVD by the band's Trouble, Inc. label in 2007'.
